KSC Commerce Programs Krishna School of Commerce 2 Programs · 6 Faculty Members Currently Viewing KSBM Management Programs Krishna School of Business Management 3 Programs · 12 Faculty Members KSC Message from the Director Dr. Rashmi Vyas Director I/C, KSC | 28 Years Experience Welcome to the Krishna School of Commerce (KSC), where education is viewed as a transformative journey that shapes not only careers but also character, values, and social responsibility. Our institution is committed to creating an academic environment that inspires intellectual growth, professional competence, and ethical leadership. In today’s rapidly evolving global landscape, we believe that education must extend beyond textbooks and classrooms. At the School of Commerce, we strive to nurture students into confident, competent, and socially conscious individuals through a balanced blend of academic rigor, experiential learning, innovation, and value-based education. Our focus is on empowering students with the knowledge, skills, and mindset required to excel in the fields of commerce, business, finance, and management. Through workshops, seminars, industrial visits, internships, skill enhancement initiatives, and mentoring support, we encourage students to explore their potential and prepare themselves for meaningful professional and personal lives. The strength of our institution lies in its dedicated faculty, supportive learning culture, and the collective commitment towards student success. The mentor system adopted by the institution ensures personalized guidance and continuous encouragement for every learner, helping them achieve academic excellence and holistic development. We encourage our students to dream ambitiously, work diligently, uphold integrity, and contribute positively to society. As future professionals, entrepreneurs, and leaders, they carry the responsibility of shaping a progressive and inclusive nation. I sincerely appreciate the relentless efforts of our faculty members, staff, students, and stakeholders whose teamwork and dedication continue to strengthen the institution’s vision and achievements. Together, let us continue our pursuit of excellence and create opportunities that empower our students to become responsible global citizens and leaders of tomorrow. Key Highlights Industry-oriented curriculum aligned with emerging trends in Business, Finance, Taxation, and Management. Holistic student development through academic excellence, professional training, and skill-based learning. Specialized courses in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, Marketing, and Human Resource Management. Practical exposure through internships, live projects, case studies, industrial visits, and fieldwork. Regular workshops, seminars, expert lectures, and industry interactions to bridge academia and practice. Strong emphasis on entrepreneurship development and startup awareness. Career guidance, placement assistance, and personality development programs for enhanced employability. Community engagement through extension activities and social awareness initiatives. Continuous internal evaluation and a student-centric teaching-learning approach. Supportive academic environment that nurtures leadership, teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills. Commitment to academic excellence, professional ethics, employability, and societal contribution. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Our Vision “To achieve excellence in commerce education by empowering students with in-depth knowledge and versatile skills in the field, while equipping students with knowledge and skills in commerce stream, inculcate values, identify hidden talents, provide opportunities for students so as to create successful entrepreneurs as well as competent human resource with global competency suitable for trade, service and industry thereby contributing well-being of society and national development.” Our Mission The school is committed to integrating all facets of commerce by providing high quality education and training. To foster a culture of innovation, entrepreneurship, and ethical business practices among students. To prepare graduates to become leaders, capable of addressing the challenges and opportunities of a rapidly changing business environment. To develop partnerships and networks with local, regional and international organizations to enhance the practical relevance of education and research in commerce. To create a supportive and nurturing environment that encourages personal growth, leadership development, and the pursuit of excellence in all aspects of commerce education.
